# Saved builtin plan settlement, 2026-10-05

This source packet adds a narrowly bounded continuation for a completed original builtin OpenTofu plan. It has not been compiled, linted or executed by the author. Independent source review and fresh root PostgreSQL/OpenTofu checks are required before integration. It does not close durable cleanup, cloud quiescence or any complete production requirement.

Eligibility is derived from the actual generated workspace: four JSON files, the pinned version, an empty external-provider lock, builtin `terraform_data`, a finite expression grammar and one absolute local `terraform.tfstate`. Unknown HCL, external providers, modules, data sources, provisioners, functions, delegated processes and provider sessions cannot mint settlement. Existing noneligible execution behavior remains separate. Protected state ancestry, owner/mode/no-follow/single-link checks and the finite native state schema are checked before producer and application tooling, and repeated before original dispatch. Physical parent device/inode plus the fixed filename supplies global backend identity; the exact approved path remains separately bound by the backend/config digests. A different logical scope cannot acquire the same physical target.

The canonical module captures runner/run prototypes privately. Finite producer, apply and readback callbacks require the exact private run and workspace before their first init. Known runs refuse changed methods, accessors, additional own methods or noncanonical command arguments before launching a child. Captured invocation fields and a fresh descriptor check prevent post-await substitutions before spawn. Cleanup captures the exact original root and repeats the private binding before marking removal complete. Revision2 repeats descriptor-only run checks immediately before later engine method reads, internal post-await normalization/application reads, and the runner finally disposal read. A substituted accessor is refused before evaluation. Unknown copied or Proxy handles are refused by private identity before inspecting descriptors or methods. This is a boundary for registered finite runs in the trusted runtime, not a blanket compromised-process claim. Private records originate only from the actual child result path and exact on-disk binary plan hash. Producer sealing requires the actual canonical plan record. Completion requires the actual original apply, full canonical init/plan/apply arguments, exact workspace and executable identities, a separate no-change purpose-specific plan and actual native state readback. Both private work directories must have been removed successfully. Caller return values, copied objects, method substitutions and SQL status projections cannot mint this evidence. Exported observations are fixed booleans, with no registrar or evidence getter.

The paired default runtime seals the terminal tuple with existing plan-artifact keys and a separate settlement AAD domain. The final native completion transaction locks its existing lease/operation/use/backend identities before the final workspace coordinator.
